client_need: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control
stem: For a routine medication order when computerized provider order entry (CPOE) is available, which ordering method does CMS identify as the preferred method?

options.A: CPOE entered directly into the electronic health record.
options.B: A telephone order relayed through a family member.
options.C: An undocumented verbal order that is entered later if convenient.
options.D: A handwritten note kept outside the medical record.

rationale: CMS states that CPOE remains the preferred method of provider order entry. Other communication methods may be permissible under regulatory and organizational requirements, but they do not replace CPOE as the preferred routine order-entry method.
educational_objective: Identify the federally stated preferred method for provider order entry.
